link to X, Facebook or LinkedIn, or a copied URL,
opens for anyone (FR-61, FR-65).

div.div:
A block hides both accounts from each other, and the
only place to lift it is the blocker's settings
(FR-62). Saves are private: the author is notified,
but no one else can see what a reader keeps (FR-64).
